note: Files the archives do not tie to a catalogued donor. 'unattributed' has no sample id at all (mostly pooled Strand-seq flowcells and multiplexed Kinnex pools). 'out_of_catalogue' names a donor with no long-read data here (1000G trio parents, Coriell lines screened but not sequenced). 'other_donors' are EnTEx/GTEx tissue donors and MGI pediatric blood donors hosted in the HPRC bucket. All are real data.
